title: Lock the east-side pilot coverage, sources and coordinate frame
goal: Establish a reproducible spatial and source contract for the first adjacent Richmond terrain tiles.

inputs.rights: Read-only starter inventory and source notices.

inputs.ref: NOAA Richmond InPort 80311 and 80312, VGIN road centerlines, Geofabrik 261117 and USGS 3DEP
inputs.rights: Preserve publisher terms and attribution in the catalog. Validate product metadata at this stage.

inputs.ref: NOAA NADCON5 grids from PROJ CDN
inputs.rights: Open geodetic grids with original provenance in the asset lock.

deliverables.purpose: Lock publisher, product and license for each input.
Lock the horizontal operations, fixture samples and grid SHA-256 values.
Lock the CRS, world origin and coverage rules.
Pin versioned OSM nodes and incident ways for three street controls.
QGIS overlay for the core, tiled terrain, acquisition halo and three controls.
List terrain tiles and exact local/engine coordinates.
Explain reproduction and next asset intake.

out_of_scope: Cooking DEM or LAZ tiles, deriving building heights, engine import and playtesting.
steps: Verify catalog metadata and datum choices.
Pin three non-collinear control intersections with versioned provenance.
Generate the pilot manifest and overlay, then check axes, seams and the NOAA horizontal transforms.

acceptance.procedure: Run the contract against the original OSM capture and pinned NADCON5 grids.
acceptance.pass_if: All capture hashes, node/way versions and horizontal projection checks pass.

acceptance.procedure: Run the Python test suite with requirements-gis.txt available.
acceptance.pass_if: Frame, height codes, neighboring tiles, control coordinates and deterministic exports match fixtures.

on_blocked: Report the missing control capture, dependency or incompatible CRS before changing the lock.
retry: Identical input bytes reproduce the geometry exports. The wrapper adds the run record.
